title: core.revisions — one document revision record
description: PROPOSED base doctrine (ruling 1 of 2026-10-13, part c; pending), every profile: spec/SPEC.md section 3.19. Law 6 keeps versions PER NODE; a document made of many nodes also needs to say which version of each node belonged to one Save. This record is that statement for one Save. The node whose type is core.revisions gains one version per Save; version N of that node carries exactly one file of this shape, and its `revision` equals N. The record is a statement about node versions that are all declared in MANIFEST.json of the same package - it references nothing outside the package (law 1). It is also the document's changelog and its undo browser (law 9: one payload, two masters). The shape is the one the first writer library to ship such a log already writes, adopted unchanged so that the packages it has written validate against this file; two other writers had each built an equivalent log of their own in an extension node. `format` values are annotations, not assertions. Standalone: no $ref to any other file.

revision.description: 1 for the first Save, then 2, 3, ... An incremental integer, never semver. Equals the `v` of the revisions node version that carries this file.

kind.description: `save` an ordinary Save. `rollback` the document was pointed back at an earlier revision (see `restores`); no bytes were removed. `set-active` one node's `active` pointer was moved by hand. `compaction` versions were compacted (explicit, signed, logged - SIGNATURE.json `compaction_log` is the authority).

restores.description: Only with kind `rollback`: the revision whose node versions this revision points back at.

note.description: The work note of this Save: one sentence saying why it exists (law 6). The same sentence is the `note` of every node version this Save created.

created.description: RFC 3339, UTC, Z suffix, second precision.

nodes.description: The document at this revision: every node that is part of it (every node of the package except the revisions node itself), mapped to the version number `v` of that node which this revision uses. Keys are node_id values of MANIFEST.json nodes[]; each value is a `v` present in that node's versions[]. A node of the package that is NOT a key here is not part of the document at this revision (it was added later, or removed earlier) - its bytes stay in the package because versions are append-only. To materialise the document at revision K: for each key, read that node at that version.
